record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, expand each existing bidirectional Transformer block's feed-forward intermediate width from 2*hidden_units to 4*hidden_units. Greater nonlinear capacity may improve masked-item contextual representations without changing attention connectivity. Retain two pre-norm blocks, GELU, residual structure, final normalization, features, embedding parameterization, readout, loss and optimizer. Update checkpoint loading and the predictor writer consistently; train and load exactly one BERT4Rec model per category.

category_rationales.rationale: Expand the GELU feed-forward intermediate width from 2× to 4× hidden_units in every bidirectional Transformer block across all four category models. This tests greater nonlinear capacity while preserving pre-norm attention, residuals, embeddings, readout, loss and optimizer. The generated predictor imports BERT4RecModel from train.py, so it automatically constructs matching checkpoint shapes.
